before: Stage 1 of ARC-0025 is applied (a [fechado] ARC-0025 message), the Story is compiled and log.txt shows 0 error(s), 0 warning(s).
Load a save with the party; the probe spells ("Probe: …") are added to every player character on load.
Any class and level. Probes are throwaway: stage 2 removes them.
Write down what you see for each probe, even when it fails: every probe has a plan B.

sessions.name: Probes
sessions.setup: The party out of combat, then a small fight for P2, P3, P5 and P6.

tests.expected: With Probe Hymn A on, Child A is castable and Child B is greyed out; with Hymn B the opposite. Casting Sing B replaces Hymn A (one icon only)
tests.fails: Both children are castable, or both greyed, or the container does not open, or both Hymn icons show.
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0025 P1 (containers locked by the Hymn, SC22)
tests.steps: Cast Probe: Sing A, open Probe: Container; cast Probe: Sing B, open it again
tests.title: A container child locked by a status

tests.expected: Below 50% HP the character shows Probe Dusk; below 25% Probe Nightfall replaces it; healed to 25-49% it is Probe Dusk again; above 50% the mark is gone; when Downed the mark is gone
tests.fails: No mark, both marks at once, a mark that stays above 50%, or a mark on a Downed character.
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0025 P2 (Dusk and Nightfall, SC10, SC11)
tests.steps: In a fight, let an ally take damage past 50% and 25%, then heal them up step by step; also let one be Downed
tests.title: Marks on a downward crossing

tests.expected: After one cast Probe Gate shows and Probe: Gated is greyed out for the rest of your turn and through the enemies' turns; at the start of your next turn the gate is gone and the spell works again
tests.fails: The gate disappears at the end of your own turn, or never disappears.
tests.steps: In a fight, cast Probe: Gated on your turn, try again, end the turn, watch it through the round
tests.title: A one-turn gate with TickType StartTurn

tests.expected: The ally slides about 9 m toward you and takes no opportunity attack
tests.fails: The ally doesn't move, is pushed away, or is hit by an opportunity attack.
tests.steps: Cast Probe: Pull on an ally standing next to an enemy, 10-15 m from you
tests.title: Pull an ally

tests.expected: You give off light about 12 m around you; out of combat the character sheet shows Perception +1; in combat the +1 is gone and the light stays
tests.fails: No light, the +1 stays in combat, or the light goes out in combat.
tests.steps: Cast Probe: Lantern, check the sheet, then start a fight and check again
tests.title: A light that switches its bonus off in combat

tests.expected: When the ally would be Downed they stay up at 1 HP with Probe Nightfall on, and the mark stays
tests.fails: The ally goes Downed, gets more than 1 HP, or ends without Probe Nightfall.
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0025 P6 (Undying Hope into Nightfall, SC18)
tests.steps: Cast Probe: Undying on an ally, then let an enemy bring them to 0
tests.title: Undying Hope leaves Nightfall

title: The Starchild — stage 1 probes
